description: PacketGuard detection rules. 'class' marks the four ledger-enabled threats (blockchain) vs the four network-hygiene rules. Thresholds tunable.

rules.name: Packet Loss / Theft
rules.detail: Gap in the sender's sequence numbers beyond the allowed window.

rules.name: Tampering
rules.detail: Received payload hash differs from the blockchain anchor.

rules.name: Replay Attack
rules.detail: A previously seen payload hash re-appears under a different sequence number.

rules.name: DoS / Spam Flood
rules.detail: A single source IP exceeds the per-second packet-rate threshold.

rules.name: Spam Activity
rules.detail: Many identical payloads from one source in a short window.

rules.name: Data Exfiltration
rules.detail: Large outbound burst to an unknown external IP, or DNS-tunneling pattern.

rules.name: Route Hijack (TTL anomaly)
rules.detail: Sudden large drop in TTL for an established flow suggests a new hop.

rules.name: MitM / ARP Spoof
rules.detail: The MAC bound to a known host IP changed from the trusted baseline.
